purpose: Declares the material each F11 assessment slot carries for the pre-RC candidate, by role, from the bound scope (classification.json partitions and application domains), the rule catalog and the role policy. It selects bytes for J; it supplies no authority and no judgment. assessment-plan.mjs constructs the slots from it.
promptBoundSource: T-287 Phase D, D5-b activation item 4: each slot's rendered prompt stays at or under 1,048,576 bytes; a slot over the bound is re-partitioned (not a stop); a slot with no lawful smaller partition is reported over the bound. D5-b disposition G-3: a slot over the bound only by the observed C2 execution material it must carry (the coverage slot, the REQ-P-QUAL-056 rule slots) enters the plan up to 3,500,000 bytes; above that it is a Product finding (owner question)

roleSources.rule: QUALIFICATION_ROLE_POLICY.authoritySourceRefs (REQ-P-SELF-CONFORMANCE.md, REQ-P-QUAL.md), as catalog sources with their packaged bytes, in every slot (validator/qualification.ts:476-481)

roles.coverage: ruleRef = one rule group, surfaceRef = the rule catalog ref, evidenceRole = catalog_fidelity (validator/qualification.ts:409-412)
roles.subject: the rule catalog member (contracts/qualification/rule-catalog.json); the owner renders every published row of each selected source (qualificationSelectedSubject, :424-441)
roles.material: the role sources and the rule groups' sources; rule groups packed in catalog order while their source bytes stay within plan.catalogPackSourceBytes

roles.coverage: ruleRef = the inventory ref, surfaceRef = one global surface group, evidenceRole = inventory_coverage and inventory_classification (:408)
roles.subject: every member of the slot's surface groups (:413-420)
roles.material: The role sources, classification and each selected group's declared actual representative sourceRefs; complete member metadata remains present. No representative or metadata establishes omitted source conformity.

roles.coverage: ruleRef = one rule group, surfaceRef = one group of that rule group's declared domain (classification.json applicationDomains), evidenceRole = semantic_assessment (:400-407)
roles.subject: the domain group's members; a domain key (a governed part or a role's complement) names the same members under every rule group whose domain has it, so one slot covers several rule groups' pairs over one key
roles.material: Declared actual sourceRefs of the complete memberRefs domain, the classification and role/rule sources. classification.json evidenceSelections declares two bounded diagnosed-case arguments by exact rule source and subject/group; their actual generator/definition evidence may be outside the assessed group but must bind to the complete inventory. Other selections keep their existing meaning. Grouping adequacy is J judgment and may remain unknown; generated-byte reproduction is not semantic compliance. Full source refs are retained for reacquisition; each criterion remains whole in one disjoint slot.

roles.coverage: ruleRef = surfaceRef = the tenant conformance manifest ref, evidenceRole = tenant_realization
roles.subject: the tenant manifest member (test_env/qualification/tenant-manifest.json)
roles.material: the role sources and the typed tenant manifest (its canonical JSON, the material F11 requires, validator/self_conformance.ts:110)

roles.coverage: ruleRef = one coverage claim, surfaceRef = one of its behaviors, evidenceRole = behavioral_coverage
roles.subject: the coverage catalog member (contracts/qualification/coverage.json)
roles.material: the role sources, the typed coverage catalog, the requirement sources its claims cite and the observed C2 execution material, which every criterion's evidence refs must name (validator/self_conformance.ts:111, :118-119)

provenance: Every task carries the construction provenance of its subject members (provenance.mjs taskProvenance): the inherited-base chain of the tree at the Phase C close (D5-b disposition G-2) and one chain per commit touching the tenant after it, each subject member under the last chain that constructed it (its postimage digest is the member's current digest), each chain restricted to those members with exactly their records, its attribution spans the whole activation, the closure's header and the closure rows of those members. One provenance entry per distinct slot subject set. The installed attribution check (validator/qualification.ts:743-805) is run over every slot's resolved provenance with established attributions before dispatch; a slot whose attribution is invalid holds dispatch.
execution: The observed C2 execution material is the C2 Result's material (abg/qualification_proof.ts:832-846: canonical JSON of the result, its judgment and its evidence). Before the C2 run, the projection and the dry mode carry a measured stand-in: the observation constructed by the installed owner from a direct run of the prepared C2 task's helper command in the prepared sandbox, under the envelope of an observed C2 Result (exact-candidate-qualification.mjs, execution-material.mjs), marked as such.

outputModel.rule: Output per slot is the canonical JSON of its raw judgment: every criterion with a reason of reasonBytes and that many source refs, and one established attribution per carried chain with the chain's scope refs

fit: The projection renders every slot's prompt with the installed renderer and measures it against the bound before any dispatch (assessment-plan.mjs projectAssessment); ruleInputFloor states the rule role's input that no partition lowers under this selection.
proofComplementBoundSource: RP-2 / approved P4: only rule/complement/proof slots; rendered bytes measured, no criterion split under sharedCoverage disjoint. The live window probe and owner budget remain D5-d-prep obligations.
